docs.title: Equipment Predictive Maintenance
docs.text: Failure prediction and remaining useful life estimation for rotating equipment.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: This machine learning system is part of the Oil & Gas ML Portfolio by Kelvin J Cabrera.

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text: Synthetic Data Generator -> Scikit-Learn Training -> Flask API -> Streamlit Dashboard

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• Data Generation: Domain-aware synthetic data with physical correlations
  • Model Training: Scikit-learn pipelines (Random Forest, Isolation Forest) with MLflow tracking
  • API: Flask/FastAPI with API key authentication
  • Dashboard: Streamlit interactive web interface
  • Testing: pytest with model evaluation metrics (R2, accuracy, F1)

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
pip install -r requirements.txt
python train.py
python app.py
streamlit run streamlit_app.py

docs.title: API Endpoints
docs.text:
Method Endpoint Description GET / Service info and available models POST /predict/{model} Run inference (requires API key)

Authentication

All API endpoints require an X-API-Key header. Set API_KEY in your environment.

docs.title: Authentication
docs.text:
All API requests require an API key sent via the X-API-Key header.

import requests

headers = {"X-API-Key": "your-api-key"}
response = requests.post("http://localhost:5000/predict/model", json={...}, headers=headers)

docs.title: GET /
docs.text:
Returns service information and available models.

Response:

{"service": "Equipment Predictive Maintenance", "models": ["model1", "model2"]}

docs.title: POST /predict/{model_name}
docs.text:
Run inference on a trained model.

Request Body:

{"features": {"feature_1": 0.5, "feature_2": 1.2}}

Response:

{"prediction": 0.85, "model": "model_name"}

docs.title: Error Codes
docs.text: Code Description 401 Invalid or missing API key 404 Model not found 422 Invalid input format

docs.title: Data Layer
docs.text:
• Data Source: Synthetic sensor data generator (EquipDataGenerator) producing 50 equipment units with 120 days of readings
  • Equipment Types: Centrifugal Pump, Reciprocating Pump, Compressor, Separator
  • Sensor Data: 16 raw features + 8 derived features (24 total)
  • Preprocessing: Feature engineering, standard scaling, train/test split

docs.title: Failure Predictor (Status Classification)
docs.text:
• Algorithm: GradientBoosting (best) among ExtraTrees, RandomForest, MLP, LogisticRegression
  • Target: Equipment status (5 classes: normal, warning, preventive_maintenance, corrective_maintenance, failure_imminent)
  • Metrics: Accuracy > 0.99, F1 Macro > 0.99
  • Output: Class label + probability distribution across all 5 states

docs.title: Life Estimator (RUL Regression)
docs.text:
• Algorithm: ExtraTrees (best) among GradientBoosting, RandomForest, MLP, Ridge
  • Target: Remaining Useful Life in days
  • Metrics: R2 > 0.99, MAE < 15 days
  • Output: Predicted days of useful life remaining

docs.title: Anomaly Detector
docs.text:
• Algorithm: Isolation Forest
  • Input: 8 key sensor readings (vibration, temperature, pressure, motor_current, bearing_temp, power_consumption)
  • Purpose: Detect abnormal sensor patterns

docs.title: API Layer
docs.text:
• Framework: Flask
  • Endpoints: 6 REST endpoints (health, dashboard, predict_status, predict_rul, anomaly_check, docs)
  • Model Loading: Lazy loading on first request

docs.title: Dashboard Layer
docs.text:
• Frontend: Flask + Chart.js
  • Sections: 4 interactive panels (Dashboard, Status Prediction, RUL Estimation, Anomaly Detection)
  • Charts: Model comparison, confusion matrix, RUL scatter plots

docs.title: Data Flow
docs.text:
1. Input: 16 sensor readings from equipment
  2. Feature Engineering: EquipPreprocessor computes 8 derived features (vibration_total, efficiency, ratios, etc.)
  3. Status Classification: FailurePredictor classifies into 5 equipment states with probabilities
  4. RUL Estimation: LifeEstimator predicts remaining useful life in days
  5. Anomaly Detection: Isolation Forest scores sensor readings for anomalies
  6. Dashboard: All results displayed in interactive panels

docs.title: Training Pipeline
docs.text:
1. Generate synthetic sensor data (50 units, 120 days)
  2. Visualize failure distribution and RUL distribution
  3. Prepare classification dataset (24 features, 5 classes)
  4. Train 5 classifiers, select best by F1-macro
  5. Prepare RUL regression dataset
  6. Train 5 regressors, select best by R2
  7. Save best models to outputs/models/
  8. Generate evaluation plots, confusion matrix, RUL predictions

docs.title: Dockerfile
docs.text:
FROM python:3.10-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

RUN python scripts/train.py

EXPOSE 5003

CMD ["python", "app.py"]

docs.title: Build and Run
docs.text:
docker build -t equipment-predictive-maintenance .
docker run -p 5003:5003 equipment-predictive-maintenance

docs.title: Docker Compose
docs.text:
version: '3.8'
services:
  app:
    build: .
    ports:
      - "5003:5003"
    environment:
      - FLASK_DEBUG=0
    volumes:
      - ./outputs:/app/outputs
    restart: unless-stopped

docker-compose up -d

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Predictive maintenance system for oil & gas equipment. Classifies equipment status (normal, warning, preventive/corrective maintenance, imminent failure), estimates remaining useful life (RUL), and detects sensor anomalies.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Python 3.8+
  • pip

docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
git clone https://github.com/kcabrera83/equipment-predictive-maintenance.git
cd equipment-predictive-maintenance
pip install -r requirements.txt

docs.title: Running Predictions
docs.text: python scripts/predict.py

docs.title: Full Evaluation
docs.text: python scripts/evaluate.py

python app.py

Open http://localhost:5003 in your browser.

docs.title: Equipment States
docs.text: Code State Description 0 Normal Operation within normal parameters 1 Warning Elevated values, increased monitoring recommended 2 Preventive Maintenance Scheduled maintenance recommended 3 Corrective Maintenance Corrective maintenance needed 4 Failure Imminent Stop equipment immediately

curl -X POST http://localhost:5003/api/predict_status \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"vibration_x": 2.0, "vibration_y": 1.5, "vibration_z": 1.0, "temperature": 65, "pressure": 200, "motor_current": 30, "bearing_temp": 75, "power_consumption": 45, "rpm": 1800, "runtime_hours": 5000}'

# Check for anomalies

  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \

docs.title: Using Python
docs.text:
import requests

# Predict equipment status
response = requests.post("http://localhost:5003/api/predict_status", json={
    "vibration_x": 2.0, "vibration_y": 1.5, "vibration_z": 1.0,
    "temperature": 65, "pressure": 200, "motor_current": 30,
    "bearing_temp": 75, "power_consumption": 45, "rpm": 1800
})
result = response.json()
print(f"Status: {result['predicted_status']}")
print(f"Probabilities: {result['probabilities']}")

# Estimate RUL
response = requests.post("http://localhost:5003/api/predict_rul", json={
    "vibration_x": 2.0, "vibration_y": 1.5, "vibration_z": 1.0,
    "temperature": 65, "pressure": 200, "motor_current": 30,
    "bearing_temp": 75, "power_consumption": 45
})
rul = response.json()
print(f"RUL: {rul['rul_days']} days - {rul['recommendation']}")

docs.title: Training Pipeline
docs.text:
The training pipeline follows these steps:

  1. Data Generation: data_generator.py creates synthetic data with domain-specific physical correlations
  2. Preprocessing: Feature scaling via StandardScaler
  3. Training: Random Forest or Isolation Forest via scikit-learn
  4. Evaluation: R2 score, accuracy, classification report
  5. Logging: MLflow tracks parameters, metrics, and artifacts
  6. Serialization: Model + scaler + metadata saved as .pkl via joblib

docs.title: Model Files
docs.text:
Models are stored in outputs/models/*.pkl as dictionaries with:

Key Description model Trained scikit-learn estimator scaler Fitted StandardScaler feature_names List of input feature names target_name Target variable name metrics Evaluation metrics from training

docs.title: Retraining
docs.text:
To retrain:

python train.py

This will update the model files in outputs/models/ and log results to MLflow.
